messages:
Marie (Partnerships): Quick FYI — NeptuneSecure signed a 3-month Private deployment pilot with Azure Confidential VMs and Managed HSM for key material. They want PHI-safe inference for their clinical triage model. :tada: :lock:
Raj (Sales): Amazing — is this a co-sell with Azure or purely our Private offering? Any contract/commitment details?
Marie (Partnerships): Co-sell with Azure partner team, but deployment will be Redwood Private in their VNet. Initial scope: pilot for 2 models, expected 500 qps at 512 seq. Contract is a pilot SOW + option to expand to Dedicated after pilot.
Liam (Eng): Nice. Need to confirm supported quantization for their models and whether confidential VMs affect our kernel choices. Also we'll need HSM integration tests for key unwrap flows.
Alyssa (Solutions): I'll own the onboarding runbook. Can someone add the HSM auth flow example? I can draft the customer-facing checklist.
Sofia (Customer Success): Onboarding call scheduled for Thu 10am PST. NeptuneSecure wants a short case study on outcomes if pilot goes well — they're open to a collaborative write-up.
Raj (Sales): Targeting expansion motion if latency < 80ms p95 and cost under $0.003/token equivalent. Will surface to AE and Azure partner manager.
Liam (Eng): From runtime side, preliminary notes: we should enable prefix caching and a conservative batch size to hit p95 targets. Also we'll lock model version so KV cache warmup is predictable. Example private deploy snippet for infra team:
```
private_deploy:
  cloud: azure_confidential
  vnet: "/subscriptions/.../vnet/neptune-prod"
  models:
    - name: clinical-triage-v1
      pin: v1.2.0
      quantization: int8
  hsm:
    provider: azure_managed_hsm
    key_uri: "https://ns-mhsm.vault.azure.net/keys/rsakey"
```
Marie (Partnerships): OpsBot created the onboarding ticket and linked architecture doc. Thanks Liam for the snippet.
OpsBot (bot): Ticket #PS-4821 created: "NeptuneSecure Private pilot - confidential VMs + HSM" (assignees: Alyssa, Liam, Sofia).
Alyssa (Solutions): I'll post the runbook draft in #eng-runtime and ping infra for firewall rules. Who can help validate HSM unwrap flow?
Liam (Eng): I can pair with infra next Tue. Also we'll need to schedule a short perf smoke test in staging with the customer's model.
Sofia (Customer Success): Sending calendar invites for onboarding and perf window. Customer asked for an exec summary after week 2 of pilot with early metrics.
Marie (Partnerships): Shoutout to Raj and Alyssa for closing and moving fast — would love volunteers for a short case study (marketing + customer quotes) if the pilot succeeds. :raising_hand:
Raj (Sales): Happy to coordinate quotes and intro to NeptuneSecure leadership.
Alyssa (Solutions): I'll capture technical artifact snapshots (configs, perf graphs) we can reuse.
Marie (Partnerships): Great. Keeping this thread for coordination — please reply here with blockers. Otherwise, I'll post a short announcement after onboarding is green. :rocket:
